escrow.title: Escrow payment
escrow.frozen: A dispute is open. The money is frozen and will not be released until it is resolved.
escrow.heldAuto: Do not dispatch on credit: the buyer has paid and the money is safe. It is released to you when the buyer accepts delivery, or automatically on {date}.
escrow.heldDefault: Do not dispatch on credit: the buyer has paid and the money is safe. It is released to you when the buyer accepts delivery, or automatically 7 days after delivery if there is no dispute.
escrow.awaitingFunding: Wait for the buyer's payment before you dispatch. You will see it here as soon as it arrives.
escrow.fee: Escrow fee (charged to you, plus GST)
escrow.payoutFailed: Failed, our team is on it
